purpose: Bound the internal Room Beacon handoff draft with mechanism research and accessibility standards. This ledger does not contain participant observations, product-performance evidence, legal clearance, or release evidence.

evidenceClasses.permittedConclusion: Make one answer commit visible, idempotent, and recoverable; provide a tap path that does not depend on motion.
evidenceClasses.prohibitedConclusion: Do not infer an error rate, intoxication level, or individual behavior.

evidenceClasses.permittedConclusion: Keep the group decision and the private countermodel distinct, allow a non-shaming dissent moment, and never optimize for speed or loudness as a proxy for fun.
evidenceClasses.prohibitedConclusion: Do not claim that Room Beacon improves consensus, inclusion, or enjoyment.

evidenceClasses.permittedConclusion: Preserve a persistent game-context beacon, concise role instruction, and an untimed tap-only recovery path under divided attention.
evidenceClasses.prohibitedConclusion: Do not claim that content is readable or understood at a particular party distance or noise level.

evidenceClasses.permittedConclusion: Provide text-plus-shape truth states, target-size constraints, reduced motion, VoiceOver/TalkBack-compatible role privacy, and native-device verification before release.
evidenceClasses.prohibitedConclusion: Do not label the app accessible or WCAG-conformant without native verification.

productDecisionBoundary: The following direction and handoff artifacts are owner-authorized internal drafts. They guide the local-first MVP only and must remain explicitly simulation-backed until an external reviewer signs current Direction and Handoff records.
